title.narrative: Support the REBAC implementation and the monitoring of natural resources by Kongolo and Kilwa ORN

description.narrative: This initiative aims at facilitating the sharing of experience between REBAC and REPAM on mineral and forest exploitation. REPAM is Pan-Amazonian Ecclesiastic Network for the protection of the Amazonian forest. REBAC works in order to allow each inhabitant living in the region of the basin of Congo river, the youth in particular, to understand the environment and climate change dynamics, to engage governements and international associations to put in place policies that protect the Congo river Basin environnment and encourage, reinforce civil society organisations and communities to take concrete behaviors and actions which protect the environment and the ecosystem. - Set up effective dialogue frameworks among public authorities of decentralised entities and civil societies in Kilwa-Kasenga - Facilitate sensitization meetings between villages to find mechanisims against bushfires and climate change.
